name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for room addition framing?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for room addition framing?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for room addition framing, look for several key qualifications. Ensure they are licensed and insured as a general contractor in California. Check their experience specifically with room additions and framing projects. Request references from previous clients and review their portfolio. Verify they have a strong understanding of local Bay Area building codes and a good working relationship with local permitting offices. Transparent communication, detailed proposals, and a clear project timeline are also important indicators of a reliable contractor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor who is licensed, insured, experienced in room additions, has strong references, understands local Bay Area codes, and offers transparent communication and detailed proposals.
